_readme: Rename this file to standards.json - do not copy it. The active name is the one .gitignore excludes. Every class the repo-inventory declaration uses must appear here, because repo-standards reads the repository-to-class mapping from there rather than restating it: a mapping written in two files is a mapping that drifts, and the drift is silent.

archived.description: Kept for the record and read-only. Requires nothing, on purpose: an archived repository refuses every write, so a standard that found a file missing would produce a pending operation that can never be applied - and a plan whose apply cannot succeed is not a plan. repo-inventory already reports archived state as skip/protected for the same reason.
